metadata.title: Mid-Century Stencil Portrait Album Cover
useCases: Soul and Rock and Roll revival branding

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast stencil portrait of a male figure set against a textured, multi-tonal background with a bold lower-third typographic banner.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is requested
bright neon color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized graphic portrait using a limited palette of dark maroon, cream, and muted blue, featuring a man in a suit rendered in a high-contrast stencil effect. The composition is anchored by a solid horizontal bar at the bottom containing sans-serif display text, all overlaid on a canvas-textured background with vertical color gradients.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast subject against a medium-value textured background
Solid horizontal footer bar grounding the vertical portrait
Textured grain unifying the graphic elements and the background
Limited color palette creating a vintage screen-printed feel
coreInvariants: High-contrast stencil rendering of the facial features and hands
Heavy canvas or linen texture overlay across the entire image
Solid color banner at the bottom for primary typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally positioned male figure from the waist up, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, solid mass of the suit and the horizontal maroon banner at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast face, move down the suit to the hands, and finally rest on the bold text in the footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured background surrounding the head and shoulders provides breathing room for the dense central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep maroon/burgundy for the suit and footer bar.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/off-white for the highlights, skin tones, and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted slate blue and tan for background gradients and mid-tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark shadows and light highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family used in two weights or sizes for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Square logo container in the bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide, and authoritative presence of the display text.
Provides a similar geometric structure and modern-retro feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast stencil-style portrait of a man in a suit, using a palette of deep maroon and cream. Place him against a textured, tan and blue vertical gradient background with a heavy canvas grain. Leave a solid maroon horizontal bar at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold, uppercase geometric sans-serif text in cream color to the left side of the maroon banner. Add a small square logo box with a circular icon to the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait rendered in a high-contrast stencil style?
Is the canvas texture visible across the entire image?
Is the text in the footer bold, uppercase, and sans-serif?
Is the color palette limited to maroon, cream, and muted background tones?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Exact wording of the artist and album title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the stencil effect doesn't lose the subject's recognizability.
Verify the texture doesn't obscure the legibility of the text.
Check that the color palette remains cohesive and vintage-inspired.
Confirm the horizontal banner is perfectly aligned at the bottom.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stencil Portrait + Canvas Texture + Geometric Sans Footer
